findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_content, get_post · Public sink: get_post, calculate_birth_chart, numerology_reading, numerology_compatibility, numerology_number_check, numerology_name_correction · Destructive: get_glossary_term, find_routine.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_content, get_post · Public sink: get_post, calculate_birth_chart, numerology_reading, numerology_compatibility, numerology_number_check, numerology_name_correction · Destructive: get_glossary_term, find_routine

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
